# One Giggle At A Time

> > A comprehensive SEL and social-emotional learning resource platform for PreK-4th grade teachers, offering social stories, classroom management tools, and visual supports.

One Giggle At A Time, created by Diane, specializes in social-emotional learning (SEL) resources designed for early childhood and elementary education. The site provides a combination of free resources, premium bundles, and classroom-ready materials including social stories, visual supports, and friendship-building tools for teachers working with PreK through 4th grade students.

## Key Topics

- Social-Emotional Learning (SEL)
- Social Stories
- Personal Space & Boundaries
- Friendship Skills
- Visual Supports
- Classroom Management
- Elementary Education
- PreK-4th Grade
- Classroom Community
- Social-Emotional Bundles
- Teacher Resources
- Early Childhood Education
- Conflict Resolution
- Classroom Environment

## Core Resources & Shop

- [One Giggle At A Time - PreK Through 4th Grade](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com): Homepage for One Giggle At A Time SEL resources for PreK-4th grade teachers
- [Shop - One Giggle At A Time](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com/shop): Shop for SEL bundles, social stories, and classroom resources for PreK-4th
- [Free Resources - One Giggle At A Time](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com/freebies): Collection of free SEL and classroom management resources for teachers

## Personal Space & Boundaries Social Stories

- [Personal Space & Boundaries Social Stories Bundle](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com/product/personal-space-boundaries-social-stories-bundle-classroom-home-community): Social stories bundle teaching personal space and boundaries across settings
- [Personal Space Social Story & Visuals Classroom Boundaries SEL](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com/product/personal-space-social-story-visuals-classroom-boundaries-sel): Classroom-focused personal space social story with visual supports for SEL
- [Personal Space At Home Social Story & Visuals](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com/product/personal-space-at-home-social-story-visuals): Home and family boundaries social story with visual supports for young learners
- [Personal Space Social Story & Visuals Community Boundaries](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com/product/personal-space-social-story-visuals-community-boundaries): Community-focused personal space social story teaching public behavior boundaries

## Friendship & Social Skills SEL Kits

- [Friendship SEL Kit Social Stories + Tools](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com/product/friendship-sel-kit-social-stories-tools-for-building-repairing-friendships): Comprehensive friendship SEL kit with social stories and conflict resolution tools
- [Friendship Repair Social Stories Bundle](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com/product/friendship-repair-social-stories-apologies-repair-and-trying-again): Social stories bundle for friendship repair, apologies, and conflict resolution
- [Feeling Left Out Friendship Social Stories Bundle](https://www.onegiggleclassroom.com/product/feeling-left-out-friendship-social-stories-bundle-exclusion-changes-rejection): Social stories for elementary students coping with exclusion and rejection
